_comment: Injective Kickpact demo, framed at the World Cup SEMI-FINAL stage. Semis are upcoming (predict them); quarter-finals are settled (one is the withdraw demo). Every tx shown is real on-chain. Order here is the final cut order.

segments.text: Kickpact is a World Cup prediction app, and it runs on Injective. Sign-in is self-custodial. A burner wallet is sealed in your own device, or an embedded wallet through Privy. No seed phrase, no custodian.
It's semi-final week. The last four are set, and the matches are live to predict. Balances, pools, and settlement all run on Injective's E-V-M.
You mint test dollars, kUSD, from the on-chain faucet. Watch the balance jump. That is a real Injective transaction, confirmed before the screen updates.
Back your call. Argentina to beat France in the semi-final. Ten kUSD leaves your wallet into an escrow contract that no admin key can touch.
Pot up with friends in person over Bluetooth. Phones discover each other and stake together, with no server between you.
Or duel a friend anywhere. Open a pool, share the code, and they join the same on-chain pot from their own phone.
Every result is a receipt. An oracle signs the final score, the contract verifies it and derives the winner on-chain, and you can check it yourself from the phone.
And when your pick comes in, you withdraw. Claim your winnings, and the funds land straight back in your wallet. On-chain, no permission needed.
It's yours, end to end. Your keys, your funds, in contracts no one else controls. Kickpact — predict together, trust the data, not us.
